text: All fixed. The issue was in `parse_flag` in `flags/parse.py`: it lowercased the input but didn't strip whitespace, so `"off "` wasn't recognized as a false word and fell through to the "any other word is True" branch. Adding `.strip()` before `.lower()` makes the behavior match the documented contract (case-insensitive, whitespace-ignoring), and also makes whitespace-only input correctly raise `ValueError`.
